title: Directly visualizing the energy level structure of quantum dot molecules
title_zh: 直接可视化量子点分子的能级结构
summary: 表征半导体量子点的能谱对于自旋量子位操作至关重要，但在广泛的参数范围内仍然具有挑战性。在这里，作者使用分子光谱将硅双量子点中的一个和两个电子能级绘制为失谐、隧道耦合和磁场的函数。
abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 15 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79672-6 Characterizing the energy spectrum of semiconductor quantum dots is essential for spin qubit operation but remains challenging across broad parameter ranges. Here, the authors use molecular spectroscopy to map one and two electron energy levels in a silicon double quantum dot as functions of detuning, tunnel coupling, and magnetic field.
